description: Evidence fingerprint and timestamp: sha256 / sha512 / keccak256 of supplied text or base64 bytes with the provider's ISO time and a statement of observation, delivered under the agent's ed25519-signed receipt. On-chain anchoring is a separate paid step. Not a notarisation or legal timestamp. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: sha256, sha512, keccak256, bytes, observed_at, statement, note.

base64.description: base64 bytes to fingerprint (default: none; supply text instead)
